extension_name.description: 擴充套件名稱。AMO 的上架頁也用這一條。

extension_description.message: Browse bookmarks as visual previews, with a password-encrypted vault for the ones you would rather not show.
extension_description.description: manifest 的簡介，出現在 about:addons 與 AMO。

command_toggle_sidebar.description: about:addons 的「管理擴充套件捷徑」裡，這個快捷鍵的說明。

crypto_decrypt_failed.message: Decryption failed: wrong master password, or the data is damaged

crypto_chunk_size_invalid.message: Chunk size must be a positive number

crypto_password_empty.message: The master password cannot be empty

crypto_dek_length_invalid.message: The data key is the wrong length; the data may be damaged

crypto_recovery_key_length.message: That is not a valid recovery key (it should be $COUNT$ characters)
crypto_recovery_key_length.description: 使用者打的救援金鑰長度不對。$COUNT$ 是正確的字元數。

crypto_recovery_key_format.message: That is not a valid recovery key

crypto_data_truncated.message: The data is damaged: it is too short

crypto_unsupported_version.description: 加密資料的格式版本比這個擴充套件新。

msg_no_response.message: The background page did not answer $KIND$
msg_no_response.description: $KIND$ 是內部的訊息名稱，例如 vault/unlock。刻意不翻譯它。

backup_invalid_json.message: This file is not valid JSON. It is either not a backup file, or it is damaged.

backup_not_a_backup.message: This file is not a backup file.

backup_wrong_extension.message: This file is not a vault backup made by this extension.

backup_newer_version.message: This backup file is newer than the installed extension. Update the extension first.

backup_missing_salt.message: The backup file has no salt, so it cannot be restored with a master password (the file is damaged).

backup_bad_iterations.message: The backup file's KDF iteration count is not valid (the file is damaged).

backup_missing_password_wrap.message: The backup file is missing the data key wrapped with the master password (the file is damaged).

backup_missing_recovery_wrap.message: The backup file is missing the data key wrapped with the recovery key (the file is damaged).

backup_missing_blob.message: The backup file has no payload (the file is damaged).

backup_filename.description: 匯出備份檔的預設檔名。$DATE$ 是 YYYY-MM-DD。只用檔名安全的字元。

vault_untitled_folder.description: 同步來的資料夾沒有名字時，補上的名稱。這會寫進資料裡。

backfill_needs_host_permission.message: Fetching preview images needs permission to access websites

image_no_2d_context.message: Could not get a 2D drawing context

pick_all_strategies_failed.message: All three ways of grabbing the image failed (direct download, in-page download, screen crop)

capture_detail_not_open.message: The bookmark was just added and no tab has it open; using "Fetch missing previews" instead

capture_detail_no_cover.message: No cover image found, and the screenshot failed too

capture_skip_inactive_tab.message: A background tab has not really been painted, so it is not captured — that would store a blank image.

capture_skip_no_permission.message: Capturing the screen needs permission to access websites.

capture_skip_api_unavailable.message: The permission was just granted and capture is being re-enabled. Visit the page again in a moment.

capture_skip_disabled.message: Automatic capture is turned off in the settings.

capture_skip_blocklisted.message: This domain is on the capture blocklist.

capture_skip_not_open.message: The bookmark was just added and no tab has it open, so there was nothing to capture. "Fetch missing previews" can pull the og:image instead.

capture_manual_ok.message: The image you picked is now this bookmark's preview.

capture_manual_not_bookmarked.message: This page is not bookmarked, so it has no preview to set.

reason.example: 三種取圖方式都失敗了

refresh_needs_host_permission.message: Fetching preview images needs permission to access websites.

refresh_done.message: The preview image has been fetched again.

refresh_done_via_og.message: The preview image was fetched again from the page's og:image.

refresh_no_cover_on_page.message: This page has no usable cover image, and the screenshot failed too.

refresh_no_cover_no_server.message: This page has no usable cover image, and it could not be fetched from the server either.

refresh_no_tab_no_server.message: No tab has this page open, and the preview could not be fetched from the server. Open the page in a tab and try again.

sync_quota_exceeded.message: The encrypted copy is about $SIZE$ KB, over storage.sync's $QUOTA$ KB budget, so it was not uploaded. Nothing on this device is affected, but cross-device sync is stuck on the previous copy — use an encrypted backup file instead.

sync_deleted_elsewhere.message: Another device deleted the vault, so sync is paused. Decide what to do in the settings.

sync_salt_mismatch.message: The vault in the cloud was created separately (different salt) and the keys do not match, so they cannot be merged. Choose which one to keep in the settings.

sync_remote_unreadable_fell_back.message: The copy in the cloud could not be opened ($REASON$), so this device's data was used instead.

sync_unavailable.message: This Firefox has no working storage.sync

sync_in_progress.message: A sync is already running. Try again shortly.

sync_in_progress_seconds.message: A sync is already running. Try again in a few seconds.

sync_no_local_vault.message: This device has no vault yet

sync_nothing_to_upload.message: There is nothing on this device to upload

vault_not_created.message: No vault has been created yet

vault_already_created.message: The vault has already been created

vault_already_on_device.message: This device already has a vault

vault_legacy_format.message: This vault uses a development-era format that the current version no longer supports. Clear it with "Give up the vault on this device" in the settings, then create a new one.

vault_remote_exists.message: There is already a vault in the cloud. Turn on sync in the settings, choose "Restore from the cloud to this device", and unlock with the same master password. (If you are sure you do not want the cloud copy, press "Remove the cloud copy" first.)

vault_remote_still_transferring.message: The encrypted copy in the cloud is still arriving — Firefox Sync sends it piece by piece. Try again shortly.

vault_no_remote_copy.message: There is no usable encrypted copy in the cloud (it may still be arriving, or sync may not be on).

vault_remote_unreadable.message: The cloud copy could not be opened: $REASON$

vault_secret_changed_elsewhere.message: The $SECRET$ was changed on another device, so this old one no longer works. Use the new $SECRET$.

vault_new_password_empty.message: The new master password cannot be empty

vault_private_folder_not_found.message: That vault folder no longer exists

vault_bookmark_not_found.message: That vault bookmark no longer exists.

vault_folder_into_itself.message: A folder cannot be moved into itself or into one of its own subfolders

vault_root_folder_not_importable.message: "Bookmarks Menu" and "Bookmarks Toolbar" are built into Firefox and cannot be moved into the vault.

vault_locked_during_merge.message: The vault locked while the merge was running, so the merge was abandoned.

thumbdb_open_failed.message: Could not open the thumbnail database

search_truncated.message: (showing the maximum — narrow the search to see fewer)

folders_none.message: There are no folders to move to.

new_folder_hint_root.message: New folder — the top level cannot hold one directly, so it goes into Other Bookmarks

new_folder_root_note.message: The top level cannot hold a folder directly, so it goes into Other Bookmarks.

toolbar_select_hint.message: Tick several items and move them all at once, into a folder or into the vault

toolbar_gallery_hint.message: Browse the bookmarks side by side across the whole window, in a new tab

preview_cover_first_hint.message: Prefer a cover image from the page (a book or comic cover, a video thumbnail) and fall back to a screenshot

preview_capture_first_hint.message: Prefer a screenshot of the page and fall back to a cover image

preview_entry_icons_hint.message: When a bookmark points to a site rather than a page in it (a path at most one level deep and no query, like google.com/maps or twitch.tv), use the site's icon as its preview. Turning this off keeps existing icons until they expire or you refresh the preview.

row_use_site_icon_hint.message: Show this site's icon instead of a cover or screenshot, and keep it that way

row_use_page_preview_hint.message: Show a cover or screenshot of the page instead of the site icon, and keep it that way

backfill_hint.message: Fetch the og:image for bookmarks that have no preview yet, and the site icon for bookmarks of whole sites that don't show one yet. This makes a request to each of those sites.

backfill_needs_permission_hint.message: Needs permission to access websites first

backfill_all_done.message: Every bookmark already has a preview.

backfill_finished.message: Done: $OK$ of $TOTAL$ bookmarks got a preview.

refresh_thumb_hint.message: Throw away the current preview and fetch it again. The result is best when the page is open in a tab, because the cover is read from the rendered page.

permission_swatches_only.message: Only domain colour cards for now.

permission_why.message: Real previews need permission to access all websites. Thumbnails stay on your device and are never uploaded.

permission_reload_note.message: The extension restarts once after you grant it.

permission_dismiss.message: Not now — keep the colour cards

group_not_found.message: That group no longer exists (it may have been dissolved elsewhere)

group_name_taken.message: This folder already has a group called “$NAME$”

group_flatten_has_folders.message: This folder contains other folders, which would have nowhere to go. Move them out first.

group_to_folder_hint.message: Create a subfolder where the group is and move its members in, in order

group_dissolve_hint.message: The members stay where they are; they are just no longer grouped

group_flatten_hint.message: Move the bookmarks inside up to this level as a group with the same name, and remove the folder

tag_label.message: Tag for this bookmark (an existing name joins that group)

row_move_earlier_hint.message: Move one cell left; the cards after it make room (Ctrl+Shift+arrow keys move in all four directions)

row_move_later_hint.message: Move one cell right; the cards after it make room (Ctrl+Shift+arrow keys move in all four directions)

row_import_folder.message: Move the whole folder into the vault

row_import_folder_named.message: Move the folder “$NAME$” into the vault

row_import_folder_hint.message: The folder goes in with everything inside it, and keeps its structure

movein_body.message: $SUBJECT$$SCOPE$ will be *removed* from Firefox's bookmarks, and only visible once the vault is unlocked.

movein_keeps_hierarchy.message: Folder structure is kept as it is.

movein_purge_history_many.message: Also clear these addresses from history

movein_purge_history_one.message: Also clear this address from history

movein_history_permission_note.message: Pressing Move in will ask for permission to read history.

vault_unlock_recovery_hint.message: The eight groups of characters you were told to write down. Case and separators do not matter.

vault_forgot_password.message: Forgotten the master password? Use the recovery key

vault_password_too_short.message: The password needs at least $MIN$ characters.

vault_password_mismatch.message: The two entries do not match.

vault_create_warning.message: If you forget the master password, the recovery key is the only way back to your data.

vault_create_body.message: The password is not stored anywhere and we cannot reset it for you. You will be given a *recovery key* — the only spare key there is. Write it down.

vault_create_acknowledge.message: I understand that losing both the password and the recovery key means losing the data

vault_legacy_title.message: This vault uses the old format

vault_legacy_cannot_open.message: The current version can no longer open it.

vault_legacy_why.message: The encryption format changed during development, to support recovery keys and password changes, and the old format was deliberately not migrated. Even the right password will not open it — clear it and create a new one.

vault_legacy_how.message: Go to the settings and press “Give up the vault on this device”.

vault_empty_hint.message: No vault bookmarks yet. Press the lock icon on the right of any row in the bookmark list to move one in.

vault_destroy_warning.message: $BOOKMARKS$ and their previews will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.

vault_delete_folder_note.message: The bookmarks and subfolders inside move up one level; they are not deleted with it.

vault_delete_bookmark_note.message: Deleted outright — it does not go back to being a normal bookmark.

vault_refresh_thumb_hint.message: Throw away the current preview and fetch it again, encrypted with your master password. The result is best when the page is open in a tab.

vault_export_hint.message: Back to normal bookmarks, into the default folder set in the settings

vault_export_folder_hint.message: The whole folder goes back to normal bookmarks, into the default folder set in the settings

vault_export_to_hint.message: Back to normal bookmarks, into a folder you pick

vault_import_one_done.message: The bookmark is in the vault

vault_import_folder_done.message: The folder is in the vault ($FOLDERS$, $BOOKMARKS$)

vault_import_history_unavailable.message: $MOVED$, but without permission to read history the addresses are still in your history and address-bar suggestions.

vault_import_history_unavailable_part.message: without permission to read history, these addresses are still in your history and address-bar suggestions

recovery_write_it_down.message: Write this recovery key down and keep it somewhere safe.

recovery_regenerated.message: This is a new recovery key. The old one no longer works.

recovery_only_way.message: If you forget the master password, *this is the only thing that can get your data back*.

recovery_no_reset.message: Without either one, the bookmarks in the vault can never be opened again. Nobody can reset it for you, including us.

recovery_keep_apart.message: Do not keep this with the encrypted backup file.

recovery_keep_apart_why.message: Keeping both in one place — the same cloud drive, the same account — means whoever gets into that account gets the ciphertext and the key together, and both layers fall at once.

recovery_acknowledged.message: I have written it down or saved it

merge_reattached.message: $COUNT$ of them were in a folder that no longer exists after the merge, and were moved to the top level.

merge_no_previews.message: The backup carries no preview images. Press “Fetch missing previews” in the sidebar to build them again.

outcome_synced.message: Checked against the cloud copy, and anything newer there has been merged in. The actual upload and download to Firefox's servers is on Firefox's own schedule, not this button's.

outcome_unavailable.message: This Firefox has no working storage.sync, so it cannot sync.

outcome_disabled.message: Sync is off, so nothing was done.

outcome_no_vault.message: This device has no vault yet, so there is nothing to sync.

outcome_locked.message: The vault is locked, so there is no key to merge the cloud copy with — nothing was read or written this time. Unlock it in the sidebar first.

outcome_waiting.message: The cloud copy is still arriving, so it was left alone this time rather than overwriting something not yet seen. It will finish on its own.

outcome_deleted_elsewhere.message: Another device deleted the vault, so sync is paused until you decide.

outcome_failed.message: The sync failed — see the message above for why.

sync_requested.message: Sync requested. The state is shown above.

options_lede.message: Everything stays on this device. Nothing is uploaded to any server.

options_lede_sync.message: Everything stays on this device. The vault also has an encrypted copy in Firefox Sync that only your master password can open.

options_entry_hint.message: When it is hidden, typing the trigger string below into the search box is what brings up the password screen.

options_entry_hidden.message: Hidden — reached with the trigger string

options_export_target_title.message: Where bookmarks land when moved out

options_export_target_hint.message: “Move out of the vault” puts them in this folder. “Move out to…” asks each time.

options_export_target_fallback.message: If this folder is deleted, the Firefox default is used instead.

options_trigger_hint.message: Typing this into the search box brings up the password screen. Any text will do.

options_trigger_advice.message: *Change this.* The default is public, so anyone who types it once can tell whether this device has a vault.

options_trigger_empty.message: Leaving it empty disables this way in. Switch the setting above to “Show a tab”, or there will be no way to reach the vault at all.

options_remote_awaiting_restore.message: There is already an encrypted copy in the cloud. Under “Sync across devices” below, press “Restore from the cloud to this device” and unlock with *the same master password*. *Do not create a second one here* — the keys would differ and the two could never be merged.

options_vault_manage_hint.message: Vault bookmarks are managed — moved out, deleted — from the sidebar once it is unlocked.

options_keys_hint.message: Either one opens the same data. If you forget the master password, the recovery key is the only way back.

options_keys_need_unlock.message: Unlock in the sidebar first to see the recovery key or change the master password.

options_new_password_again.message: Type the new master password again

options_password_changed.message: The master password has been changed. Use the new one next time you unlock.

options_need_current_password.message: Enter the current master password above first

options_regenerate_hint.message: The old one *stops working immediately* — throw away the copy you wrote down.

options_regenerate_action.message: Generate a new one (needs the current master password)

options_regenerated.message: A new recovery key has been generated and is shown above. The old one no longer works.

options_forget_title.message: Give up the vault on this device

options_forget_hint.message: The only way out when both the master password and the recovery key are gone. Clearing the encrypted data on this device lets you start over, but *the bookmarks inside cannot be recovered*. The cloud copy is untouched.

options_forgot.message: The vault on this device has been cleared.

options_backup_hint.message: *Forget the master password and it can never be opened.* A backup keeps the data from disappearing with this computer, but it still needs the master password it was made with.

options_backup_hint2.message: The file is encrypted (AES-256-GCM), so a cloud drive or a USB stick is fine. It carries *no preview images* — those can be fetched again.

options_export_needs_unlock.message: Unlock the vault in the sidebar first — that also proves you still remember the password this backup will need

options_export_no_vault.message: This device has no vault yet, so there is nothing to export

options_exported.message: Exported $FILENAME$. If no download appeared, save the contents below yourself.

options_download_fallback.message: No download appeared? Copy the contents here

options_download_fallback_hint.message: Select all, copy, and save it as a `.json` file. The contents are encrypted.

options_restore_hint.message: If this device has no vault yet, you will unlock with this backup's password from now on. If it already has one, *unlock in the sidebar first* — the restore merges entry by entry, keeping the newer of each.

options_file_unreadable.message: That file could not be read.

options_restore_needs_unlock.message: This device already has a vault and it is locked. Restoring into an existing vault needs it unlocked, because the merged result has to be written back with this device's key.

options_sync_hint.message: Put an *encrypted* copy into Firefox Sync. Other devices get it by ticking the same box and entering the same master password. The password itself is never synced.

options_sync_not_seen.message: Other devices cannot see it yet?

options_sync_not_seen_1.message: This checkbox only writes the encrypted copy into this machine's `storage.sync`, which takes seconds. Getting it to the other device is Firefox's own schedule, roughly every 10 minutes. To skip the wait, press “Sync Now” in `about:preferences#sync` — *on the source device first, then on the receiving one*.

options_sync_not_seen_2.message: Once the new device has the data, typing the trigger string into the search box should bring up the *unlock* screen. *Do not press “Create a vault”* — the keys would differ and the two could never be merged.

options_sync_checkbox.message: Put an encrypted copy into Firefox Sync

options_sync_on.message: On. The encrypted copy is being uploaded.

options_sync_off.message: Off. The cloud copy is still there — use the button below to remove it.

options_sync_unreadable.message: Could not read the sync state: $REASON$

options_sync_remote_partial.message: still arriving — some pieces are missing, so sync waits rather than overwriting

options_sync_deleted_elsewhere.message: *Another device deleted the whole vault, so sync is paused.* The data on this device is still here and untouched — a flag from elsewhere should not be able to destroy local data. To keep syncing with this device's data, press “Ignore the deletion and sync again” below. If you want it gone here too, unlock in the sidebar and delete the vault.

options_sync_over_quota.message: This device's encrypted copy is over the 100 KB sync budget, so sync stays on the previous copy. Nothing on this device is affected. With this many bookmarks, use the encrypted backup above instead.

options_sync_different_vault.message: The cloud holds a *separately created* vault (a different salt). The keys do not match, so they cannot be merged automatically. Pick one: use “Overwrite the cloud with this device” below, or export a backup on the other device and restore it here.

options_sync_now_hint.message: Makes this device read, merge and write its local storage.sync right now. It does not make Firefox upload or download — that is “Sync Now” in about:preferences#sync.

options_sync_needs_checkbox.message: Tick “Put an encrypted copy into Firefox Sync” above first

options_sync_adopt.message: Restore from the cloud to this device

options_sync_adopted.message: The cloud copy has been restored to this device. Unlock it with the same master password.

options_sync_resume.message: Ignore the deletion and sync again

options_sync_resumed.message: The deletion marker was ignored. Syncing continues from this device's data.

options_sync_overwrite.message: Overwrite the cloud with this device

options_sync_overwrite_hint.message: Makes the cloud copy match this device. Anything on another device that has not synced here yet is lost.

options_sync_overwrite_disabled.message: This device's copy is over the sync budget, so overwriting would fail after clearing the cloud copy. Disabled for that reason.

options_sync_overwritten.message: The cloud copy now matches this device.

options_sync_clear.message: Remove the cloud copy and turn sync off

options_sync_cleared.message: The cloud copy has been removed. Nothing on this device is affected.

options_sync_limit_android.message: *Firefox for Android does not sync `storage.sync` at all* (Mozilla bug 1625257). On a phone, the encrypted backup file is the only way to get the data.

options_sync_limit_schedule.message: Firefox syncs roughly every 10 minutes, not instantly. “Check the cloud copy now” only makes this device read, merge and write its local `storage.sync` — it does *not* make Firefox upload or download.

options_sync_limit_account.message: You need to be signed in to a Firefox account with “Add-ons” ticked in the sync settings. The extension *cannot tell* whether that is the case — writes succeed while signed out, they just go nowhere. Use the cloud copy's last-updated time above to judge whether sync is really running.

options_sync_limit_stale.message: If the copy was written before you signed in — or before “Add-ons” was ticked — Firefox may never treat it as pending and never send it. Pressing “Overwrite the cloud with this device” once rewrites it.

options_sync_limit_unlocked.message: Merging only happens while *unlocked*. Locked, nothing is pushed or pulled: without the key the cloud copy cannot be opened, so uploading would be plain overwriting and would lose whatever another device added.

options_sync_limit_salt.message: *The salt, the KDF iteration count and the wrapped data key sit in the synced data in the clear*, because a new device needs them to derive the same key from your master password and to tell that it derived the right one. The cost, stated plainly: anyone with access to your Firefox account can take them and guess the password offline. The bookmarks themselves stay encrypted. So make the master password long — and this is why sync is off by default.

options_sync_limit_quota.message: The budget is 100 KB. If the encrypted copy exceeds it, sync stops and warns above; nothing on this device is affected.

options_sync_limit_previews.message: Preview images are not synced — too large. Press “Fetch missing previews” once on the new device.

options_autolock_hint.message: Counted from the last time you did something in the vault. It also locks when you leave the computer, after the same number of minutes idle.

options_autolock_hint2.message: Closing the sidebar locks it too. The full-page view and this settings page also count as “open” — with either of them open, closing the sidebar does not lock immediately, and the timer above takes over.

options_capture_enabled.message: Make a preview automatically when you visit a page you have bookmarked

options_recapture_before.message: Capture again when a preview is older than

options_blocklist_hint.message: One per line, matched as a substring of the hostname.

options_reset_sitewide_hint.message: The extension remembers which og:images are site-wide logos and demotes them. Reset this after a site is redesigned.

options_sitewide_reset.message: What was learned about site-wide images has been reset.

gallery_select_hint.message: Tick several items and move them all into a folder at once

gallery_vault_empty_hint.message: No vault bookmarks yet. In the sidebar, use the lock icon on the right of a bookmark, or “Select”, to move some in.

group_links_only.message: Only bookmarks can go into a group, not folders

group_tag_hint.message: Click for options; drag to move the whole group — other cards make room (Ctrl+Shift+arrow keys move it one step)

grid_frame_hint.message: Gather the selected bookmarks and frame them as one untitled group

grid_auto_hint.message: Stop pinning the column count; wrap with the window width again (groups wrap along, they don't break up)

options_grid_sync_hint.message: Groups (tags) and pinned column counts from the full-page view sync to your other devices through Firefox (the order already syncs with the bookmarks). They always use 20 KB of the sync space; the rest is left for the private space.

options_grid_sync_unavailable.message: Sync storage isn't available in this Firefox, so layout and groups stay on this device.

options_grid_sync_over.message: Layout and groups take $USED$, over the $BUDGET$ budget, so syncing them has stopped (they stay on this device). The largest are:

options_grid_sync_local_only.message: “$TITLE$” $BYTES$ — too large for one sync item, kept on this device only

row_move_up_hint.message: Move up one place; moving next to a group member joins that group (Ctrl+Shift+Up)

row_move_down_hint.message: Move down one place; moving past the last member leaves the group (Ctrl+Shift+Down)

search_tag_hint.message: Type #name to find every bookmark with that tag, across all folders

group_tag_search_hint.message: Click to open the folder this group is in
